name: T01
justification: Always includes the current time.

name: T02
justification: Eventually includes the current time.

name: T03
justification: Always includes the next time step.

name: T04
justification: If p always holds, it eventually holds.

name: T05
justification: Time t+1 is a witness for Eventually.

name: T06
justification: Duality of Eventually and Always (A1).

name: T07
justification: Next commutes with negation (A3).

name: T09
justification: p holds at t=0 but is false thereafter.

justification: p is false at t=0 and true thereafter.

name: T11
justification: p is false at t=0 and true at t=1.

name: T12
justification: p is true at t=0 and false at t=1.

name: D01
justification: If both hold at every time, each holds at every time.

name: D02
justification: Both propositions hold at every time.

name: D03
justification: Always distributes over conjunction.

name: D04
justification: Next distributes over conjunction.

name: D05
justification: Next distributes over disjunction.

name: D06
justification: Eventually distributes over disjunction.

name: D07
justification: Any future witness for p is also a witness for q.

justification: p and q alternate, so neither holds forever.

justification: p and q alternate and never hold simultaneously.

justification: p is always false and q is always true.

name: D12

name: N01
justification: Every suffix of an always-p trace satisfies always p.

name: N02
justification: A future witness of a future witness is a future witness.

name: N03
justification: Always includes the current time.

name: N04
justification: A witness after t+1 is also a witness after t.

name: N05
justification: If p eventually holds forever, every suffix contains p.

name: N06
justification: Both sides require p at every time from t+1 onward.

name: N07
justification: p alternates forever between true and false.

name: N08
justification: p is false initially but true from t=1 onward.

name: N09
justification: p holds only at t=0.

name: N10

name: I03

name: I09

name: I10

justification: Recursive expansion of weak until (A8).

justification: p is always true and q is always false.
